parts.name: waist_pitch_M_fixed_metal_eye
parts.note: Machined 6061-T6 eye; 2 x M3 tapped mounting holes; friction lining reacts into this eye; integral angular travel guards reacting directly into bearing eye; D14.50 x0.85 upper retaining counterbore, flat Z3.15; two M2 tapped upper reaction mounts and shallow countersink runout

parts.name: waist_pitch_M_radial_bush
parts.note: D6 journal +0.06 mm nominal diametral clearance; not part of axial preload loop; D14.40 x0.70 flange at Z3.20..3.90, captured below thrust washer Z4.00; 0.15 total nominal axial float

parts.name: waist_pitch_M_friction_lining
parts.note: 1 mm replaceable lining with positive edge tabs; friction coefficient is an untested assumption; unfilled machined PEEK candidate, dry contact; actual torque and creep must be qualified

parts.name: waist_pitch_M_flanged_rotor_shaft
parts.note: Integral D6 drive, journal and friction flange; blind M3 end thread and M2 radial retention; no threaded running surface; integral load-bearing flange stop tab; magnetic cup is not a stop; extended D-flat above bearing Z4 drives upper pressure plate; journal below Z3.9 remains round; D8/flat3.5 output below flange, D6 journal preserved; 7075-T6 material candidate; radial M2 pilot retained

parts.name: waist_pitch_M_thrust_wear_washer
parts.note: Custom removable ground 17-4PH H900 reaction washer, 1 mm web and keyed upper PEEK pocket; captures radial bush flange below Z4

parts.name: waist_pitch_M_spring_seat
parts.note: Ground 17-4PH H900 pressure plate with 1.85 mm deep D6 hub; 0.2 mm radial gap to reaction washer, lower hub clear of POM flange
